summary: The latest advice is to keep the one hundred dollars in cash in America and to buy HDFC Bank in India. The analysts are talking about why Infosys has been a poor investment, losing value over five years while paying a dividend that does not make up for the loss. They also explain that ten dollars is too little to join a typical US stock offering, and they break down the thirty eight rupees in fees for a ten thousand rupee trade of Reliance on Zerodha.
